fluff.overview: Irian BattleMechs Unlimited, the military division of the Free Worlds League industrial giant Irian Technologies, takes a direct approach to facility security. Deploying from full-sized APCs, Irian SWAT teams wear the heaviest unpowered armor available to conventional infantry and carry Imperator AX-22 assault rifles backed by David light Gauss rifles as secondary weapons. The combination delivers firepower that can threaten light combat vehicles and challenge even battle armor at close range. The weight of their ballistic plate armor and heavy weapons loadout makes these troops slow and unable to conduct anti-BattleMech swarming attacks, but their role is facility defense rather than mobile warfare. Irian's vast factory complexes on worlds across the Free Worlds League demand security forces capable of standing their ground against serious threats, and these SWAT teams are built for exactly that purpose.
